PZZ700-252015-
1222 AM PDT Sun Oct 25 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 AM, a 1023 mb high was 450 nautical miles west of San 
Francisco, CA and a 1012 mb low was over the southern Gulf of 
California. Weak offshore flow near shore during the nights and 
mornings will alternate with onshore northwest flow during the 
afternoons and evenings through Tuesday. Stronger onshore flow 
Monday afternoon and evening may gust to 20 knots. More steady 
onshore flow expected from Wednesday onward

$$
